audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's meditation on human mortality: flower/shadow imagery, clean/unclean question, limits of days, tree hope, Sheol concealment, longing for renewal, and erosion imagery.

verses.restored: A human born of woman is short of days and full of trouble.

familiar.text: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

modern.text: “Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.

original.text: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע רֹֽגֶז

verses.restored: He comes out like a flower and withers; he flees like a shadow and does not stand.

familiar.text: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

modern.text: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.

original.text: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד

verses.restored: Do you open your eyes on such a one and bring me into judgment with you?

familiar.text: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

modern.text: Do You open Your eyes to one like this? Will You bring him into judgment before You?

original.text: אַף עַל זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ

verses.restored: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

familiar.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

modern.text: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!

original.text: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: Since his days are determined, the number of his months is with you; you have set his limits, and he cannot pass them.

familiar.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

modern.text: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,

original.text: אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חקו עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר

verses.restored: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he enjoys like a hired worker his day.

familiar.text: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

modern.text: look away from him and let him rest, so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand.

original.text: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: For there is hope for a tree: if it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its shoot will not cease.

familiar.text: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

modern.text: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.

original.text: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל

verses.restored: Though its root grows old in the earth and its stump dies in the dust,

familiar.text: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

modern.text: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil,

original.text: אִם יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ

verses.restored: at the scent of water it will bud and make branches like a young plant.

familiar.text: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

modern.text: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling.

original.text: מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ נָֽטַע

verses.restored: But a strong man dies and lies low; a human expires, and where is he?

familiar.text: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

modern.text: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?

original.text: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Waters fail from a sea, and a river wastes away and dries up;

familiar.text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

modern.text: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry,

original.text: אָֽזְלוּ מַ֭יִם מִנִּי יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: so a man lies down and does not rise; until the heavens are no more, they will not awake or be roused from their sleep.

familiar.text: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

modern.text: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, he will not be awakened or roused from sleep.

original.text: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם

verses.restored: If only you would hide me in Sheol, conceal me until your anger turns back, set a fixed time for me, and remember me!

familiar.text: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

modern.text: If only You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed! If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me!

original.text: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי

verses.restored: If a strong man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I would wait, until my change comes.

familiar.text: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

modern.text: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.

original.text: אִם יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי

verses.restored: You would call, and I would answer you; you would long for the work of your hands.

familiar.text: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

modern.text: You will call, and I will answer; You will desire the work of Your hands.

original.text: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף

verses.restored: For then you would count my steps; you would not keep watch over my sin.

familiar.text: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

modern.text: For then You would count my steps, but would not keep track of my sin.

original.text: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל חַטָּאתִֽי

verses.restored: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and you would plaster over my guilt.

familiar.text: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

modern.text: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.

original.text: חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל עֲוֺנִֽי

verses.restored: But a mountain falling crumbles, and a rock is moved from its place;

familiar.text: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

modern.text: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place,

original.text: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: waters wear away stones; floods wash away the dust of the earth; so you destroy the hope of a mortal.

familiar.text: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

modern.text: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.

original.text: אֲבָנִ֤ים שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ

verses.restored: You overpower him forever, and he passes; you change his face and send him away.

familiar.text: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

modern.text: You forever overpower him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.

original.text: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: His children are honored, but he does not know it; they are brought low, but he does not perceive them.

familiar.text: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

modern.text: If his sons receive honor, he does not know it; if they are brought low, he is unaware.

original.text: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Only his flesh pains him, and his soul mourns over him.

familiar.text: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

modern.text: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.”

original.text: אַךְ בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל
